_source: **Expected exemption ₹68,000.** LTA received ₹1,20,000; Bengaluru → Delhi, flown, ₹68,000 for the family. The fare the Rules admit is entered as ₹80,000 so the amount incurred binds (DR 08: "air fare limb — NEEDS VERIFICATION"). TY 2025-26's block is 2022–2025: one journey already claimed in it, this one on 10-10-2025 (erratum below DR 08 T5, D-153).
